relations.name: realtime_subscribe_log
relations.reason: Current app uses owner-held SECURITY DEFINER RPC only; direct client table writes and all service table grants are unnecessary to that caller. Historical comments permit direct own INSERT and manual service audit/cleanup, but no continuing caller is present. Recommend owner-role operations for manual audit; explicitly record this narrowed route.

relations.name: users
relations.reason: Self row/profile fallback only; profile INSERT comes from Auth trigger owned by postgres. No email/streak column SELECT, no direct reward/system-field UPDATE, no client/service INSERT/DELETE. Keep avatar_object_key=null fallback subject to existing guard. is_admin SELECT is a DELIBERATE, TIME-BOXED STAGE A COMPATIBILITY RETENTION, not part of the secure end state: shipped Build 33 (iOS f5594171, pinned web ebf091c2) reads it at src/lib/admin.ts:31 and, without the grant, takes 42501 which the shipped catch turns into isAdmin=false — every admin silently loses the admin UI. It is revoked by 20260910120000_phase03a_fda026_stage_b_cutover once no client reading public.users directly is still in the field. FDA-026 stays OPEN until then.

relations.name: users_self_email
relations.reason: No current caller; SECURITY INVOKER already cannot obtain email through the existing revoked underlying email SELECT. Remove unused view privileges. Do not grant email to make a previously unavailable path pass.
